name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (released 2026-07-04) is a major release spanning 238 commits. Highlights include Connect Knowledge (read-only access to Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive/SharePoint, and Dropbox per room), an expanded 52-connector Integrations Hub (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), and agent Channels with @mention support. Other notable additions include a Telegram remote-control gateway, clean-path routing replacing hash-based URLs, PBKDF2 password hashing with rate limiting, and a conversation run timeout raised to 1 hour. See the full release notes at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits and active contributor activity
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt, login rate-limiting, KB_PASSWORD gate, and mobile/reverse-proxy support

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron. Old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser, but the canonical form is now path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from '.slack' to '.channels', scoped per room.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more advanced document management with OCR and tagging but is significantly heavier and more complex to self-host than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a more feature-rich document management system with workflows and permissions, but requires more resources and setup compared to Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud is a comprehensive self-hosted cloud platform that far exceeds Cabinet in features but introduces significant overhead for users who only need simple file management.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell focuses on automatic document organization and OCR processing but has a steeper learning curve and heavier infrastructure requirements than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: FileRun
alternatives.review: FileRun offers a polished file manager with cloud sync and sharing features, but its premium tiers and closed-source nature contrast with Cabinet's lightweight open approach.
